reasoning: Three acts in one turn. The halt: measuring is running and he never asked for it, so it stops — a halt changes the state of running work and creates nothing. The correction: he draws a boundary the halt alone does not carry — a quick measurement on the platform, taken before deciding how complex the transitions will be, is the one he did voice and it stands; that narrows the constraints of work already in flight rather than opening anything new. The observation: he names a defect in how the intake behaves — an auto-ticket fires on any stray remark instead of thinking — and a judgment about the product is its own act even when it doubles as the reason for the halt, because it is worth keeping after this work closes. No new piece of work follows: a halt and a correction change work that already existed, so there is nothing accepted whose dimensions or specialists could be named, and answering an accusation of inventing work by inventing a task for it would repeat the exact mistake he reported.
